title: EU AI Act Article 53 — GPAI provider documentation duties
doctrine: human-in-the-loop attestation of evidence — NOT conformity certification

checkpoints.requirement: Public documentation surfaces (model cards, usage policy, safety policy) tracked with signed byte-change cards
Training-content summary published by the provider (Art 53(1)(d))
checkpoints.guidance: Only the provider can attest the existence/adequacy of their own summary. Machine evidence can show the surface changed; adequacy is human.

checkpoints.requirement: Named accountable owner signs this attestation cycle
